December 12, 2025 20:00 ET | Source: Nasdaq, Inc.

NEW YORK, Dec. 12, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Nasdaq announced the annual reconstitution, which will become effective prior to market open on Monday, December 22, 2025.

The following two companies will be added to the Index: Insmed Incorporated (Nasdaq: INSM), Western Digital Corp. (Nasdaq: WDC).

As a result of the reconstitution, the following two companies will be removed from the Index: Biogen Inc. (Nasdaq: BIIB), The Trade Desk, Inc. (Nasdaq: TTD).

For information about the companies, visit their websites.
